purpose: Test a genuinely path-accumulated photon-clock law that is not an endpoint lapse rewrite, using one internally consistent point-mass lens model and exact row-access accounting while exposing its conservation cost and cleanest empirical falsifier.

law.name: path-aged Weyl-exposure redshift
law.spacetime: A Lorentzian metric g_ab, a future-directed null curve gamma, and a unit timelike physical congruence u^a fixed by the coarse-grained matter rest frame.
law.path_measure: d ell = -u_a dx^a for every future-directed ray segment; this scalar one-form contraction is invariant under coordinates and ray reparameterization.
law.path_age: s(P)=integral from emission e to P of d ell, with s(e)=0.
law.curvature_driver: q_W=(abs(C_abcd C^abcd)/48)^(1/4), with dimension length^-1. For Schwarzschild, q_W=sqrt(r_g)/r^(3/2), r_g=GM/c^2.
law.infrared_activation: A(s)=1-exp(-s/L_H), L_H=c/H0. This is not fitted: H0 is frozen at 70 km s^-1 Mpc^-1. A(0)=0 and A approaches one only after long propagation.
law.transport: ln[(1+z_obs)/(1+z_GR)]=alpha E_gamma, E_gamma=integral_gamma A(s) q_W d ell.

free_parameters.role: one universal signed coupling, estimated only from a future exploration response and then frozen

law.thin_lens_specialization: Use one point-mass model throughout. For observed faint/bright flux ratio R in (0,1], infer y=(1-sqrt(R))/R^(1/4). Signed image roots are x_plus=(y+sqrt(y^2+4))/2 and x_minus=(y-sqrt(y^2+4))/2, each satisfying y=x-1/x. From the observed separation, theta_E=theta_sep/sqrt(y^2+4); b_plus=D_l theta_E x_plus and b_minus=D_l theta_E abs(x_minus); r_g=(D_l D_s/(4 D_ls)) theta_E^2. The accumulated baryon-frame path age at the lens is s_lens=(c/H0) integral_zlens^zsource dz/[(1+z)E(z)], not a scaled comoving or angular-diameter distance. The same Schwarzschild point mass then gives E0(b)=sqrt(pi)*Gamma(1/4)/Gamma(3/4)*sqrt(r_g/b), approximated across a thin lens by A(s_lens)E0(b).
law.differential_prediction: For two images of the same delayed source, Delta ln(1+z)_extra=alpha[E(b_inner)-E(b_outer)]. It survives common endpoint, cosmological, and source-redshift cancellation.
law.preferred_frame_caveat: The law is covariant after u^a is physically specified, but it is not frame-free. A fundamental completion must derive u^a rather than choose it by coordinates.

causality: s is accumulated only from the emission event toward the observation event
q_W and u^a are evaluated locally on the past light path
any dynamical field producing q_W or a Weyl one-form must use retarded source support
no response or future endpoint value enters the transport law
conservation: photon number may remain conserved, nabla_a N^a=0
for alpha nonzero the photon stress tensor alone cannot obey nabla_a T_gamma^ab=0 in a stationary lens because its frequency changes
a complete theory must provide a compensating field/source stress tensor with nabla_a(T_gamma^ab+T_comp^ab+T_source^ab)=0
until that compensator follows from an action, this package is a kinematic effective law and not a fundamental theory
null_propagation: the metric null cone and image directions are retained at this stage
a non-affine frequency rescaling must not be mistaken for a derived Maxwell eikonal
a future action must reproduce both the frequency transport and its backreaction

exact_controls: C_abcd=0 gives E_gamma=0, including Minkowski and exactly conformally flat FLRW
two paths with identical q_W exposure give zero differential signal
an exact one-form B=d phi gives endpoint-only transport and zero closed-path holonomy
equal impact parameters give zero strong-lens differential signal
zero lens mass gives zero signal
the local short-path limit is quadratic: E_gamma is suppressed by s^2/(2 L_H) for fixed q_W and s much smaller than L_H

real_preflight.input_scope: The local TSV contains 12 SQLS/COSMOGRAIL predictor rows and is parsed in full: eight exploration predictors are used, four confirmation predictors are parsed but never used, and no response file or response row is opened.
real_preflight.source_model: MODEL_LIFTED_EXACT_POINT_MASS: R=abs(mu_minus)/mu_plus; y=(1-sqrt(R))/R^(1/4); x_plus=(y+sqrt(y^2+4))/2; x_minus=(y-sqrt(y^2+4))/2; theta_E=image_separation/sqrt(y^2+4); b_plus=D_l theta_E x_plus; b_minus=D_l theta_E abs(x_minus); r_g=(D_l D_s/(4D_ls))theta_E^2; both exposures use the Schwarzschild q_W of this same mass.
real_preflight.path_age_mapping: For the frozen flat FLRW baryon congruence, d ell=-u_a dx^a=c dt along the photon ray, so s_lens=(c/H0) integral_zlens^zsource dz/[(1+z)sqrt(omega_m(1+z)^3+omega_lambda)]. The formerly used proxy (chi_source-chi_lens)/(1+z_lens) is retained only as explicit rejected counterevidence.
real_preflight.response_definition: After correcting the known time delay, measure the common narrow-line or narrow-absorption centroid separately in both images and report Delta v=c Delta ln(1+z), its covariance, wavelength dependence, epoch, and line identifier.
real_preflight.future_exploration_fit: Fit one universal alpha to exploration spectra using the signed per-unit-alpha coefficient. No per-lens alpha and no formula selection are allowed.
real_preflight.future_confirmation: Freeze alpha and all nuisance handling before opening any disjoint lens systems or the four sealed Item-24 confirmation identities.
required_nuisance_channels: differential magnification of a rotating or structured source
intrinsic spectral variability sampled at the lens time delay

comparator_map.distinction: For a stationary lens, -xi_a k^a is conserved and a photon that enters and exits the same potential has no residual static path redshift; unequal paths do have lensing and Shapiro/geometric delays.

A real path effect already exists when gravitational potentials evolve. It is proportional to time variation of the metric potentials and vanishes for an exactly static lens; the proposed q_W exposure does not.
FLRW is conformally flat, so q_W is exactly zero in the homogeneous background. Multiple images share the background factor, while the proposed foreground differential remains.
Cold-plasma group delay scales approximately as frequency^-2 and may scatter or scintillate; the proposed centroid shift is achromatic.
Dust changes flux and colour rather than applying one common multiplicative shift to every narrow-line wavelength.
Static lensing changes direction, magnification, and arrival time but not the conserved stationary-lens frequency. The comparison must align source epochs by the measured time delay.
These are published GR/astrophysical causes of image-to-image spectral shifts and must be jointly modelled, not counted as evidence for path accumulation.
